name: glb-designer-mobile
description: Asset Studio Stage 10b — mobile designer regression leg. Drives the REAL GLB designer UI on a 390x844 phone viewport (run with SHOT_VIEWPORT=390,844 SHOT_TOUCH=1): open the designer, add a Box by TAPPING the toolbar tile, select it by TAPPING its layer row, numeric-edit its size, open the Templates disclosure + insert a Coffee table, then save the asset end-to-end. Every interaction is a real tap/type; a screenshot is captured at each step so the mobile layout (no overflow, non-colliding viewport overlays, 44px touch targets) stays regression-guarded.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: tap-add-box
steps.comment: Real tap on the Box toolbar tile.

steps.name: assert-box-added
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__glbDesigner.getSpec(); if (s.parts.length !== 1 || s.parts[0].kind !== 'box') throw new Error('expected 1 box, got '+JSON.stringify(s.parts.map(p=>p.kind))); })()

steps.name: tap-select-box
steps.comment: Select the box by TAPPING its layer row.

steps.name: edit-size-x
steps.comment: Numeric-edit the box width (Size X) — set the controlled React input to 0.9 m.
steps.eval: (function(){ const inp = document.querySelector('.glb-designer input[aria-label="box size X"]'); if(!inp) throw new Error('size X input not found'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(inp), 'value').set; setter.call(inp, '0.9'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.name: assert-resized
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__glbDesigner.getSpec(); const sx = s.parts[0].size[0]; if (Math.abs(sx - 0.9) > 0.001) throw new Error('expected size X 0.9, got '+sx); })()

steps.name: open-templates
steps.comment: Open the Templates disclosure by tapping its summary.

steps.name: arm-coffee-table
steps.comment: Tap the Coffee table archetype to arm its parametric preview.

steps.name: scroll-to-use
steps.comment: Bring the armed card's Use-template button into view before tapping (it sits below the fold once the card expands).
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn=[...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer button')].find(b=>/Use template/.test(b.textContent||'')); if(!btn) throw new Error('Use template button not found'); btn.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); })()

steps.name: insert-template
steps.comment: Insert the template's editable parts alongside the box.

steps.name: assert-inserted
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__glbDesigner.getSpec(); if (s.parts.length < 3) throw new Error('template did not insert parts, total='+s.parts.length); if (!s.partGroups.some(g=>/Coffee/i.test(g.name))) throw new Error('no Coffee table group; groups='+JSON.stringify(s.partGroups.map(g=>g.name))); })()

steps.name: set-asset-name
steps.eval: (function(){ const inp = document.querySelector('.glb-designer input[aria-label="Asset name"]'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(inp), 'value').set; setter.call(inp, 'Mobile Coffee Table'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.name: scroll-to-save
steps.comment: Bring the Save asset button into view (bottom of the scrolling controls column) before tapping.
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn=[...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer button')].find(b=>/Save asset/.test(b.textContent||'')); if(!btn) throw new Error('Save asset button not found'); btn.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); })()

steps.name: assert-saved

waitFor.store: state.userFurniture.length > window.__glbBaseline && state.userFurniture.some(d => d.name === 'Mobile Coffee Table' && typeof d.byteSize === 'number' && d.byteSize > 0)

steps.failMessage: the mobile-built asset should persist with a byteSize
